name: draw-tech-studio-tools
systemGuidance: These are local backend image tools available to Draw Tech. Use them to keep prompts production-minded and layer-safe. Do not invent capabilities outside this manifest.

packages.label: sharp
packages.purpose: High-speed image pipeline for resizing, compositing, alpha-safe normalization, and export.

packages.label: jimp
packages.purpose: Pure JavaScript bitmap utility for future paintovers, masking, and pixel-level transforms when a fallback tool is useful.

packages.label: pngjs
packages.purpose: Raw PNG reader and writer for pixel inspection, alpha bounds, and low-level image analysis.

packages.label: pixelmatch
packages.purpose: Pixel diff tool for spotting near-duplicate layer variants and weak iteration jumps.

packages.label: image-size
packages.purpose: Fast dimension inspection for uploads and generated assets.

capabilities.name: Canvas normalization
useWhen: A generated image must be resized to the project's final canvas.
Layer exports need consistent HashLips-ready dimensions.

capabilities.name: Layer stack safety checks
useWhen: Checking alpha bounds and whether a layer touches edges.
Estimating if an isolated layer is too empty or too full.

capabilities.name: Duplicate detection
useWhen: Comparing a new variant against earlier variants in the same layer.
Flagging when iteration drift is too small to be worth keeping.

capabilities.name: Reference inspection
useWhen: Reading attachment dimensions before routing a prompt.

capabilities.name: Bitmap fallback edits
useWhen: A future workflow needs simple programmatic paintover or bitmap transforms.
A pure JavaScript fallback is safer than a heavier native graphics stack.
